responses: At the counter, Ponticius offered two hundred gold for the Sun Ruins, half now and half when the artifact was returned, and slid a pouch forward. Max countered with three hundred and said they would leave tonight, but Ponticius scowled, laughed, and gave a final offer of two fifty, while Arin urged Max to take it because they needed the coin. Max agreed, took the pouch, and the deal was struck.

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: "Two hundred gold for the Sun Ruins. Half now, half when you bring back the artifact." He slides a pouch across the counter.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: "Make it three hundred and we leave tonight."

messages.speaker: Ponticius
messages.text: He scowls, then laughs. "Two fifty. Final offer."

messages.speaker: Arin
messages.text: "Take it, Max. We need the coin."

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: "Deal." I take the pouch.

responses: At the abandoned mill, as rain hammered the roof and the wheel groaned in the flood, Lady Ashworth accused Max of being followed and said she had told him to come alone. Max denied it and asked what she had for him. Lady Ashworth handed him a sealed letter, saying it was proof that the governor ordered the fire and warning him to guard it with his life.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text: Rain hammers the roof of the abandoned mill. Somewhere below, the wheel groans in the flood.

messages.speaker: Lady Ashworth
messages.text: "You were followed. I told you to come alone."

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: "Nobody followed me. What do you have for me?"

messages.speaker: Lady Ashworth
messages.text: She hands over a sealed letter. "Proof that the governor ordered the fire. Guard it with your life."

responses: Max knelt by the fallen guard and found a ring of iron keys and a folded duty roster. Vex noted the next patrol was in ten minutes and urged movement, so Max unlocked the cell door and pulled out the thin old prisoner. The old man clutched Max’s arm and whispered the name Corvin, leaving the moment tense and urgent.

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I kneel by the fallen guard and check his pockets.

messages.speaker: Narrator

messages.speaker: Vex
messages.text: "The roster says the next patrol is in ten minutes. Move."

messages.speaker: Max
messages.text: I unlock the cell door and pull the prisoner out.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text: The prisoner, a thin old man, clutches your arm and whispers a name: Corvin.
